rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Limit concept:** The limit of f(x) as x approaches a describes the value that f(x) approaches as x gets arbitrarily close to a (but not equal to a).  ·  **Notation:** lim(x→a) f(x) = L means f(x) gets arbitrarily close to L as x approaches a.  ·  **Direct substitution:** If f is continuous at a, then lim(x→a) f(x) = f(a).
